full_page.content:
1955, March 20
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of messages written on Seraphic Mass Association cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Jack Bickel - for speedy recovery, God willing, body and soul and every way - March 20th - 1955 Fr. Solanus O.F.M. Cap.
God bless J.B. Shake off excessive worry. Offer all to God. Fr. Solanus.
1957, March 17
( other card to a Mr. Hoffa )
3/ 17/ '57
What is Religion? Ah! The science of Heaven come down to Earth: The science of our happy dependenc on God and one another, the science whereby Almighty God makes men like to Himself, viz. - men co-operating with the grace of God.
Apr. '57. Bles'd be God in all His designs! God bless you Hoffa
Real busy men are not, as a rule, too religious. The Lord who died for us, however, will always find something good - the busyest if at least now and then, they have a heart for His poor.
